sentences.text:
This miscellaneous petition has been preferred by the petitioners under Article 227 of the Constitution of India, against the order dated 09.04.2025 passed in MJC No.148/2023 by Member,
MACT, District Ratlam whereby claim of the respondent/claimant has been entertained despite not filing within six months of occurrence of the incident.

2. Facts in brief are that a claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 was filed on 15.09.2023 regarding the injuries occurred in motor vehicles accident dated 09.12.2022 along with an application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that issue of limitation is under consideration before Hon'ble Apex Court for adjudication in SLP (C) No. 9152/2023.
Therefore, Tribunal be directed not to pass final order in MJC No.148/2023.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:25329 2 MP-4974-2025 5.

In view of submission of learned counsel for the petitioner, it is directed that Tribunal shall proceed with the case, but it shall not pass final order in the case, till disposal of the issue of limitation before the Hon'ble Apex Court.
6. With the aforesaid observations, this petition is disposed of.
